## Matrix visualization

_Rows are probability (5 at top, 1 at bottom). Columns are impact (1 at left, 5 at right). Each cell holds the IDs of risks with that probability–impact pair, comma-separated. Empty cells remain blank._

| Probability ↓ / Impact → | **1 — Negligible** | **2 — Minor** | **3 — Moderate** | **4 — Major** | **5 — Catastrophic** |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **5 — Almost certain** | _[IDs]_ | _[IDs]_ | _[IDs]_ | _[IDs]_ | _[IDs]_ |
| **4 — Likely** | _[IDs]_ | _[IDs]_ | _[IDs]_ | _[IDs]_ | _[IDs]_ |
| **3 — Possible** | _[IDs]_ | _[IDs]_ | _[IDs]_ | _[IDs]_ | _[IDs]_ |
| **2 — Unlikely** | _[IDs]_ | _[IDs]_ | _[IDs]_ | _[IDs]_ | _[IDs]_ |
| **1 — Rare** | _[IDs]_ | _[IDs]_ | _[IDs]_ | _[IDs]_ | _[IDs]_ |

**Legend.**

- **Green zone** — score 1–6. Default response: accept or monitor.
- **Yellow zone** — score 7–14. Default response: mitigate or transfer.
- **Red zone** — score 15–25. Default response: avoid, transfer, or escalate to sponsor.
